scope: Message envelopes with reduced economic player payloads and abbreviated unrelated action options. They are not complete playable state fixtures. Alternative branches are independent. Terminal envelope omits intervening play. No examples are runtime tests.
scenario_preconditions: All offered regular construction plans are covered by production in their base snapshot; unrelated public production fields are omitted.
Only one wonder of each family in real base-game setup; multi-grant fixtures are explicitly synthetic.
Source abilities use target stage activation; the current binary has not migrated these wonder definitions.

acceptance_cases.title: Current-turn sale
preconditions: ordinary sale of Aqueduct; Halikarnassos stage succeeds
expected: no choice before all ordinary actions commit

acceptance_cases.title: Sixth-card remainder
preconditions: sixth regular turn; seat has no seventh-card right
expected: remainder enters discard before end-of-turn choice
no sale coins for the remainder

acceptance_cases.title: Buried card excluded
preconditions: a hand card constructs a wonder stage
expected: buried instance absent from pile and options
other hand cards never erased by discard index

acceptance_cases.title: Duplicate type across ages
preconditions: Press age I already built; Press age II in discard

acceptance_cases.title: Physical copies
preconditions: two distinct instances of one type are in a synthetic discard fixture
expected: other instance remains with the same ID

acceptance_cases.title: Stale offer
preconditions: open discard decision offered at revision 102

acceptance_cases.title: Wrong actor
preconditions: discard decision belongs to seat 1

acceptance_cases.title: Identical replay
preconditions: discard request already applied
expected: same card count, grant state, revision and effect event

acceptance_cases.title: Request identity conflict
preconditions: req-discard already has stored content

acceptance_cases.title: Closed decision with new request
preconditions: discard decision already resolved
acceptance_cases.event: submit a new request ID for it

acceptance_cases.title: Atomic failure
preconditions: card in central pile and grant active
expected: controlled resolution_error abort if internal invariant failed

acceptance_cases.title: Empty discard
preconditions: grant produced; discard is empty
expected: no invented coins or hand action

acceptance_cases.title: Only duplicates
preconditions: every discarded type already built by actor
expected: same no-options completion as empty pile

acceptance_cases.title: No voluntary decline
preconditions: legal options exist
expected: can_skip=false and no skip option in base game

acceptance_cases.title: Synthetic simultaneous grants
preconditions: synthetic grants for seats 2 and 0, then two source events for seat 0
expected: within seat 0 source-event then effect-index order
not a claim of BGA expansion priority

acceptance_cases.title: Refresh after preceding choice
preconditions: two synthetic grants; first consumes instance X
expected: old option IDs cannot select X again

acceptance_cases.title: Fresh seventh-turn snapshot
preconditions: Babylon right built on sixth regular turn; prior income and production now committed

acceptance_cases.title: No seventh-card actor
preconditions: no eligible seat after sixth-turn queue
expected: next era or scoring after age_end

acceptance_cases.title: Last seventh-card grant
preconditions: an age III seventh-card action triggers a discard choice in a controlled fixture
expected: no final score or results.txt until grant closes

acceptance_cases.title: Age/final barrier
preconditions: all regular, remainder, seventh and grant work closed
expected: finished only after age III end effects

acceptance_cases.title: Income cannot fund same turn
preconditions: actor starts with 0 coins; another seat pays it 2 this turn; offered build costs 2

acceptance_cases.title: New producer cannot be bought
preconditions: neighbor constructs Sawmill in same regular turn
expected: new wood absent from all current purchase plans

acceptance_cases.title: New discount cannot finance source action
preconditions: discount/free-build ability created by current action
expected: new ability appears at correct later opportunity

acceptance_cases.title: Independent choice production
preconditions: owner uses Clay Pit; another seat buys its clay
expected: choice allocation isolated per buying action

acceptance_cases.title: Simultaneous color counts
preconditions: neighbor builds brown while Vineyard is constructed; Lighthouse counts itself
expected: all resulting coins wait until next round

acceptance_cases.title: Later discard reconstruction counter
preconditions: regular Vineyard; neighbor later rebuilds a brown card from discard
expected: ordinary coin counts fixed before end-of-turn discard choices
later brown/grey discard construction causes no retroactive payout

acceptance_cases.title: Multiple decisions same turn
preconditions: discard choice follows regular action without turn increment
expected: ability/options read from engine instead of wonder ID

acceptance_cases.title: History and collector
preconditions: learner took a regular action then owns a discard choice at same turn
expected: foreign choices do not create learner actions

acceptance_cases.title: Decision timeout
preconditions: configured 10000 ms deadline expires before discard choice

acceptance_cases.title: Explicit abort after ordinary commit
preconditions: ordinary actions already applied; discard still pending

acceptance_cases.title: Previous game command
preconditions: same engine seed but a new game_id
expected: no state or RNG action effect

acceptance_cases.title: Accepted is not applied
preconditions: one regular action accepted; other seats still missing
expected: no money/card changes before batch resolution
accepted receipt advances to applied only on commit

acceptance_cases.title: Atomic bundle notification
preconditions: complete commands bundle written; ready signal matches
expected: deduplicate each request if bundle is redelivered

acceptance_cases.title: Invalid/mismatched bundle
preconditions: ready and commands batch IDs differ or JSON incomplete
expected: wait for consistent delivery or configured abort

acceptance_cases.title: Terminal replay
preconditions: finished already published with receipts
acceptance_cases.event: read again or redeliver earlier request while process still serves it
expected: no new effects, military conflict or results file write

acceptance_cases.title: No retained right next round
preconditions: grant consumed, auto-closed or cancelled
expected: no new grant from old wonder stage
only a new successful source event can create a new grant
